name: orphans-and-archetypes-join-candidates
title: Orphans and Archetypes: closest traditions, compositions and join candidates for the unplaced fragments of the Hittite corpus (TLHdig 0.3)

sources.title: Thesaurus Linguarum Hethaeorum digitalis (TLHdig) Beta Version 0.3

resources.name: fragments
resources.description: One row per text in Laroche's residual bins and per EBo piece.

fields.name: txtid
fields.description: TLHdig text id (publication number; a trailing + marks a text TLHdig already stores as a join).

fields.name: filed_under_cth
fields.description: CTH number under which TLHdig files the text (Laroche's catalogue, as on the Portal).

fields.name: laroche_bin
fields.description: The residual bin the text comes from: CTH 470, 500, 670, 832, the CTH 390-469 rituals no study groups, or an EBo piece filed under another CTH.

fields.name: is_ebo
fields.description: True for the EBo pieces (fragments rediscovered at Boğazköy in 2025, transliterations only).

fields.name: n_words_analysed
fields.description: Words with a TLHdig word analysis: what the model reads.

fields.name: n_words_legible
fields.description: Legible words, analysed or not (used by the spellings-only check).

fields.name: tlhdig_url
fields.description: The text in TLHdig on the Mainz Portal.

fields.name: konkordanz_url
fields.description: The text in the Konkordanz der hethitischen Keilschrifttafeln (first piece of a join).

fields.name: status
fields.description: placed: the nearest tradition leads the runner-up by at least the margin; below_margin: scored but not placed; too_small: fewer than 5 analysed words, no results.

fields.name: tradition_1
fields.description: Nearest reference tradition (highest cosine similarity to its centroid).

fields.name: similarity_1
fields.description: Cosine similarity to tradition_1 (0-1).

fields.name: tradition_2
fields.description: Second-nearest tradition.

fields.name: similarity_2
fields.description: Cosine similarity to tradition_2.

fields.name: tradition_3
fields.description: Third-nearest tradition.

fields.name: similarity_3
fields.description: Cosine similarity to tradition_3.

fields.name: margin
fields.description: similarity_1 minus similarity_2: how clearly the nearest tradition wins.

fields.name: placed_tradition
fields.description: tradition_1 if margin >= the calibrated margin (see README), else empty.

fields.name: fit_floor
fields.description: Open-set fit floor for a fragment of this size: 5th percentile of the similarity of reference windows of the same size to their own tradition.

fields.name: below_fit_floor
fields.description: similarity_1 is below fit_floor: the fragment fits no tradition as well as 95% of genuine members do.

fields.name: nearest_with_outside_genres
fields.description: Nearest class when eight outside genres (myths, prayers, oracles, historical texts, instructions, cult inventories, other festivals, Taurisa rituals) are added as classes.

fields.name: nearest_is_outside_genre
fields.description: nearest_with_outside_genres is an outside genre, by at least the margin: the fragment may not be a ritual or festival of the reference traditions.

fields.name: spellings_only_placed
fields.description: Tradition placed by the spellings-only check (sign n-grams of every legible word, reference including manuscripts without word analyses), else empty.

fields.name: spellings_only_agrees
fields.description: Both models place the fragment and agree. Empty if either does not place it.

fields.name: common_features_share
fields.description: Share of the margin carried by features attested in at least 25% of reference texts (e.g. nu, the sign a). Negative: common features pull against the decision.

fields.name: rests_on_common_features
fields.description: More than half of the margin comes from common features: the placement rests on common material and is weaker.

fields.name: compositions_top5
fields.description: The five nearest compositions (CTH numbers outside the residual bins), '; '-separated, nearest first.

fields.name: compositions_top5_similarity
fields.description: Cosine similarity to each of compositions_top5.

fields.name: manuscripts_top5
fields.description: The five nearest manuscripts in the whole release, '; '-separated, nearest first.

fields.name: manuscripts_top5_similarity
fields.description: Cosine similarity to each of manuscripts_top5.

fields.name: manuscripts_top20
fields.description: The 20 nearest manuscripts; details for each in join_candidates.csv.

fields.name: join_candidates
fields.description: Those of the 20 nearest manuscripts that pass all three join checks.

fields.name: words_function_words
fields.description: Share of the analysed words in the word category 'function words'.

fields.name: words_verbs
fields.description: Share of the analysed words in the word category 'verbs'.

fields.name: words_realia
fields.description: Share of the analysed words in the word category 'realia'.

fields.name: words_agents_and_deities
fields.description: Share of the analysed words in the word category 'agents and deities'.

fields.name: words_places
fields.description: Share of the analysed words in the word category 'places'.

fields.name: words_animals_body_nature
fields.description: Share of the analysed words in the word category 'animals body nature'.

fields.name: words_abstract_nouns
fields.description: Share of the analysed words in the word category 'abstract nouns'.

fields.name: words_adjectives
fields.description: Share of the analysed words in the word category 'adjectives'.

fields.name: words_foreign_words
fields.description: Share of the analysed words in the word category 'foreign words'.

fields.name: words_other_words
fields.description: Share of the analysed words in the word category 'other words'.

resources.name: join_candidates
resources.description: One row per fragment and each of its 20 nearest manuscripts, with the join barcode.

fields.name: txtid
fields.description: The fragment (as in fragments.csv).

fields.name: rank
fields.description: 1 = nearest manuscript.

fields.name: candidate_txtid
fields.description: A manuscript of the whole release with 5+ analysed words.

fields.name: candidate_cth
fields.description: CTH number under which TLHdig files the candidate.

fields.name: candidate_group
fields.description: The candidate's reference tradition, residual pool ('CTH 390–469 residue', 'CTH 500 Kizzuwatna fragments'), 'orphan' (CTH 470 or EBo), the Laroche bin, or empty for other CTH numbers.

fields.name: candidate_n_words
fields.description: Analysed words of the candidate.

fields.name: similarity
fields.description: Cosine similarity of fragment and candidate.

fields.name: barcode
fields.description: One character per distinct content word of the fragment, in line order: S = the candidate has the word spelled the same way, W = spelled differently, . = absent.

fields.name: fragment_content_words
fields.description: Distinct content words of the fragment (numbers and broken words left out).

fields.name: shared_words
fields.description: Content words of the fragment found in the candidate (S + W).

fields.name: same_spelling
fields.description: Shared words spelled identically (S).

fields.name: different_spelling
fields.description: Shared words spelled differently (W).

fields.name: shared_phrases
fields.description: Two-word phrases of the fragment (adjacent words) that also occur in the candidate, '; '-separated.

fields.name: check_half_the_words
fields.description: Check 1: the candidate has at least half of the fragment's content words.

fields.name: check_same_spellings
fields.description: Check 2: every shared word is spelled exactly as in the fragment (one scribal habit).

fields.name: check_shared_phrase
fields.description: Check 3: at least one shared two-word phrase.

fields.name: passes_join_checks
fields.description: All three checks pass: a join candidate (or a duplicate copy) to check on the tablets.

fields.name: candidate_tlhdig_url
fields.description: The candidate in TLHdig.

fields.name: tradition
fields.description: Reference tradition.

fields.name: cth
fields.description: Its CTH numbers (Laroche), space-separated.

fields.name: reference_manuscripts
fields.description: Reference manuscripts (17+ analysed words).

fields.name: defining_study
fields.description: The study that argued for the tradition.

resources.name: compositions
resources.description: The compositions (CTH numbers) used for compositions_top5.

fields.name: cth
fields.description: CTH number.

fields.name: manuscripts
fields.description: Manuscripts with 5+ analysed words that make up the composition's centroid.

fields.name: tradition
fields.description: Reference tradition or residual pool of the CTH number, if any.
